title: Unload during a held disinfection run leaves the tank set-point at the disinfection target
claim: When the entry unloads (or is removed) while the integration holds the pump's disinfection program on, the tank set-point stays at the cycle target 60 instead of the configured 50, because release() computes its baseline row while the disinfection hold is still live.
mechanism: coordinator.async_shutdown calls LegionellaGuard.async_release_switch (DisinfectionSwitch.release_blind turns the switch off but leaves memo True) and then pump_arbiter.release, whose desired(coord, inp, None) reads inp.disinfecting (the memo) in _dhw_target and so writes, or finds already written, the cycle temperature. The same row reads the action's dhw_reason legionella, so a plan-booked cycle step unloaded has the same seam.

evidence.machine: box B11 (shared, up to three compute seats)
evidence.contention_note: two other compute seats may share B11; the number is a count, contention-immune

instrumented_symbol: pump_arbiter:release (pump_arbiter:_dhw_target via desired) after legionella:LegionellaGuard.async_release_switch, from heatpump_optimizer:async_unload_entry

perturbation.change: PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub $HOME/venv-ci/bin/python3 dev/audit/rounds/round11/D16/s3/m6_restore.py --perturb memo: LegionellaGuard.async_release_switch also sets disinfect.memo = None before pump_arbiter.release runs

metric_definition: 1 when the tank set-point after unload differs from the configured dhw_setpoint (50) in the arm where the disinfection program was held on; key = state the delivered calls left.
phenomenon_property: The baseline row written when the optimizer lets go (unload, and Off once D16-s3-01 writes one) carries the configured tank set-point, never the live step's cycle target, whatever the disinfection hold or the action's dhw_reason says.
seam_rule: grep -n 'disinfecting\|REASON_LEGIONELLA' custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/pump_arbiter.py (each read reachable from release()/desired(..., None, ...))

null_control.value: unrestored_unload__number.dhw_set=0 (same arm without the disinfection hold); null_unrestored_unload_disinfecting=0
null_control.note: without the hold the release writes 50

proposed_fix_scope: pump_arbiter.release (and the Off baseline write) builds the baseline row with the cycle flags cleared, or the unload clears the disinfection hold before the arbiter's release.
